what_it_does: Introduces UltraAttn, a system for efficiently processing long contexts in attention mechanisms across multiple GPUs by dividing the context hierarchically into blocks. Attention—the mechanism that allows language models to weigh the importance of different parts of input—becomes a communication bottleneck when contexts are long; this work optimizes how blocks of context are routed between GPUs to minimize network overhead and maximize utilization of each processor's compute capacity.
